faq_heading: Homes near Langley Meadows Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Langley Meadows Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Langley Meadows Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Langley Meadows Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Langley Meadows Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 224 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,062,500, townhomes $725,000, condos $452,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Langley Meadows Elementary?
faq.a: Near Langley Meadows Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 22 days to sell and closed at 97.3% of the list price, with 5% over asking, across 224 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Langley Meadows Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Crescent Heights Academy (0.7 km west), Katzie Elementary (1.3 km north-west) and R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary (1.3 km north-east).

The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Langley Meadows Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Langley Meadows Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Langley Meadows Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Langley Meadows Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 224 homes sold within 1 km of Langley Meadows Elementary: 52 houses, 71 townhomes and 101 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $452,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Langley Meadows Elementary

17 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Langley Meadows Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other, 1 middle; 3 independent). The closest is Crescent Heights Academy, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Don Christian Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Katzie Elementary (1.3 km); the nearest secondary school is Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley (2.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunrise Ridge Elementary (2.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Katzie Elementary (1.3 km north-west), R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary (1.3 km north-east), Latimer Road Elementary (1.7 km south-west), Hazelgrove Elementary (1.9 km north-west), Maddaugh Elementary (2.4 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary, 1.3 km north-east of Langley Meadows Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Langley Meadows Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Langley school finder. A home a few blocks from Langley Meadows Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Langley Meadows Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 1 km of Langley Meadows Elementary was $452,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Katzie Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.3 km north-west of Langley Meadows Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
